text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. speaker: Doctor
text: Does she recall any specific nightmares or dreams after these episodes, and has there been any recent stress or trauma in her life? I also need to know if she snores or stops breathing during sleep.

text: My main symptom is Difficulty sleeping with episodes of waking up frightened. I also have Yelling and crying during sleep episodes, Temporary post-episode tiredness, Recollection of bad dreams, Bedtime procrastination.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since she recalls the bad dreams and can be consoled, these episodes sound like night terrors rather than sleep terrors, but I need to rule out sleep apnea. Does she snore loudly, gasp for air, or have restless legs during the night?
